meta.source: MATE ROV Competition classes in scope: Scout, Navigator and Ranger
meta.year: not tied to a year; limits read from the 2025 and 2026 manuals
meta.scope_note: Only the three classes the program teaches. Pioneer and Explorer, the college classes, are not covered. Class here is skill and experience level, not grade band: all three overlap in grades. The ladder compares what the manuals read (2025 Scout, Navigator and Ranger; 2026 Scout) require; limits and timings are from those years and change, so check the current manual.
meta.codes_note: Codes SCOUT, NAVIGATOR and RANGER are this project's labels.
meta.license_note: Paraphrased from MATE's class pages and manuals, which are (c) MATE under a Creative Commons NonCommercial NoDerivatives license; nothing is copied.
meta.ladder_note: Scout is a subset: Navigator and Ranger add to it.
ladder: Adds 115 volt AC for surface equipment
Hydraulic and pneumatic within pressure limits
Same family as Navigator (not read in full)
Adds a jobsite safety analysis, pre-inspection documents and a company safety review

items.name: Scout
items.paraphrase: The starting class, for teams new to robotics, recommended for elementary, middle and beginning high schools and open to grades K to 12, with elementary teams needing their regional coordinator's approval.

items.name: Navigator
items.paraphrase: The next step, recommended for middle schools with robotics experience, high schools new to robotics and advanced elementary schools, open to grades 5 to 12.

items.name: Ranger
items.paraphrase: For middle and high school teams with robotics experience and a good grasp of robotic systems and electricity, open to grades 5 to 12, with teams taking part in a regional event.
